person.note: アフマド・アッ=シハーブ・イブン・アル=バーバー。クルアーン諸読誦法（キラーアート）に秀でた。アブー・アムルの読誦法、およびアル=フサーム・ブン・フライズ（の伝）が彼のもとで読誦された。
Aḥmad al-Shihāb b. al-Bābā. He excelled in the Qurʾānic readings (qirāʾāt); the reading of Abū ʿAmr and [that of] al-Ḥusām b. Ḥurayz were recited under him.

The clause "وتلا عليه لأبي عمرو والحسام بن حريز" is ambiguous: عليه may make the subject the teacher (someone recited these readings to him) or the pupil (he recited under an unnamed teacher). "al-Ḥusām b. Ḥurayz" may denote a reading-transmitter/text or a person. Left unstructured pending review — no teacher/student relation forced.
